materialLimitations: Identical synthetic DB/file/process/condition seams and80ms/zero budgets; no application SQL, ownership, cleanup, privacy or timing proof.
No asynchronous interruption during the library interval; the separately reviewed IRQ run owns that axis.
Stdout records aggregate completion only, not per-comparison traces/branch activation. Actual Java assertions compare the observations but do not preserve their raw values.
First-Throwable identity is asserted when the original actually returns that injected Throwable. Generic failure messages and result object identity are not runtime-equality assertions.
Cached-tick/terminal/final-observation behavior is supported by copied source and differential read/effect oracle for the exercised finite modes, not exhaustive scheduling.
